sloka: ततो वसिष्ठस्तेजस्वी सर्वं निरवशेषतः ।चकार विधिवद्धर्मं महाप्रास्थानिकं विधिम् ।। ७.१०९.३ ॥
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭhastejasvī sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ ।cakāra vidhivaddharmaṁ mahāprāsthānikaṁ vidhim ।। 7.109.3 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lustrous Vasishtha completely performed all the rituals for the great departure according to scriptural injunctions.
